summary: Your homepage has named reviews and Legal500 quotes, but menus that go nowhere, unfinished text and no clear next step weaken a strong reputation.

findings.problem: Team, Expertise, Sectors, Practice Areas and the top Contact Us link all point to #.
findings.cost: A client who wants to see your team or reach you from the top bar lands nowhere.
findings.fix: Working menus and one clear Contact page.

findings.problem: No contact form on the page, no button in the hero, and WhatsApp is only a small icon by the phone number.
findings.cost: Corporate clients decide in seconds, and with no clear next step many leave.
findings.fix: Hero button, short enquiry form and a labelled WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: The name appears as HAS Law Firm, Hamdan Al Shamsi Lawyers and Al-Shamsi-Legal. A review still shows the placeholder [specific parties].
findings.cost: Awards lose force when the page looks unfinished or the brand is unclear.
findings.fix: One brand name and proofread, current copy.

findings.problem: The same practice list appears three times, Read more appears 25 times, a review is repeated, and there are no case results or founder photo.
findings.cost: A long repeated page hides your real strengths.
findings.fix: A short practice grid, case results and a founder profile.

redesign: A clear enquiry path on every page: form, WhatsApp and call.
Case results, named reviews and a founder profile that build trust.
